data.label: include
data.reason_zh: L3M让agent把摸索出的过程写成Lean程序并作为工具回存到harness，供后续复用，属可自扩展工具库的方法论文。

scope_support.feedback_quote: When an agent works out a procedure
scope_support.object_quote: it can write it once as a sealed Lean program whose type is its permission request
scope_support.persistence_quote: the harness offers it back as a tool -- machinery for the model to use
